attributes.name: content column width
attributes.definition: How wide the main content column is relative to the viewport on desktop.

values.definition: Content column is narrow, well under half to about half of the viewport.
Content column is moderately wide, roughly 55-70% of the viewport.
Content column spans most of the viewport, roughly 70-90%.
Content spans essentially the entire viewport width.

attributes.name: people profile card grid
attributes.definition: Whether the page presents a grid of person profile cards (photo plus name and role or location).

values.definition: A grid of cards each with a photo, a name, and role/location text.
People are shown as a list or without photos.
No people profile cards on the page.

attributes.name: content section rendering completeness
attributes.definition: Whether page content sections render fully or appear blank, truncated, or missing.

values.definition: Content sections display fully with their expected content.
Some sections are blank, truncated, or missing.
